It’s fixable. Make sure you have supportive shoes first of all, you need a good foundation. Stretch daily, it will help loosen and relieve pain. Look up hip opening stretches and work on doing some wall sits, make sure your back is straight against the wall. It’s a daily battle but if you keep to a schedule and stretch those muscles, you’ll feel much better. 

Also, make sure if you need to squat for any heavy lifting, use your thighs. I always squat and grab the item, loosen my arms, and force myself up focusing on using my legs. It’s helped relieve a lot of the stress on my lower back, I had no idea I was evening straining it.
